title: μP (Maximal Update Parametrization):
prompt: **μP (Maximal Update Parametrization):** How do frontier labs tune learning rates and initialization scales on a tiny 40M parameter proxy model and transfer those exact optimal hyperparameters directly to a 70B parameter training run without re-tuning?
